method.storage: fresh DuckDB file per repeat in system temporary directory
method.import: file read, parse, normalize, deduplicate, schema creation and transaction
method.same_snapshot_reimport: file read/validation plus existing immutable snapshot lookup; zero inserted
method.analysis: new read-only connection, snapshot lookup and all five aggregate SQL resources
method.excluded: fixture generation, network, HTTP, browser rendering and export serialization

limitations: Synthetic local workload; no production throughput, HTTP rate or comparative speed claim.

Correctness assertions are workload-specific; this is not a general data-quality accuracy evaluation.
